comment: Enemy Territory takes the centred uniform 4:3 correction with no per-element
rules. Its limbo panel, which is the furthest this engine's ET client currently
reaches, is one full-screen composition: pinning its pieces to different edges
would pull it apart, exactly as it would Elite Force's loading emblem.
Rules for the in-game HUD are deliberately absent rather than guessed. Closing
the limbo panel needs a key press, and the runtime harness injects no input, so
ET's health, ammunition, compass and stamina draws have never been recorded.
Author them from a cl_hudDump capture once the client can reach ordinary play.
